title: 最龙幻想
description: Become a hybrid, rise as a Dragon King. 20+ incantations, bloodline system, no dependencies.
body:
最龙幻想 (The Dream of Dragon)
——觉醒你的龙族血统，吟唱灭世言灵

你是否曾幻想过，在方块世界中唤醒沉睡于血脉深处的龙族之力？《最龙幻想》是一款基于《龙族》小说世界观开发的 Minecraft Forge 模组，让你真正成为混血种，在生存与战斗中一步步走向龙王之路。

✨ 核心玩法
🧬 血统系统
每一次新游戏，你都会随机获得 S/A/B/C 四大血统等级。血统决定你的精神力恢复速度、可获得的言灵稀有度上限，以及永续的增益效果（如 S 级自带生命恢复）。高贵的血统带来无与伦比的力量，但也让你背负更沉重的命运。

🗣️ 言灵系统
超过 20 种言灵等待你觉醒——从「炽」的火焰喷射、「镰鼬」的风刃领域，到「君焰」的毁灭火球、「莱茵」的核爆终结。每种言灵都有独特的视觉表现与机制，且血统越低能抽到的言灵越稀有。释放言灵消耗精神力，而精神力恢复速度由你的血统决定——S 级混血种几乎无休无止，C 级则需精打细算。

💥 爆血·临时血统升华
面对强敌时，你可以主动“爆血”，临时提升血统等级（如 A→S），获得更强大的言灵与增益，但期间也会承受虚弱、失明等副作用。30 秒后血统恢复原状，一切代价都由你承担。

🎭 沉浸式交互
释放言灵时，周围玩家都会看到华丽的大标题与副标题，施法者头顶爆裂粒子特效。

部分言灵拥有独特的施法前摇、粒子追踪、范围压制等机制，战斗体验层次分明。

未来计划加入八大君王、白王、奥丁等 BOSS 战，带来更宏大的挑战。

⚙️ 技术兼容
完全基于 MCreator 2024.4 开发，支持 Forge 1.20.1。

无需任何前置模组，开箱即玩（部分言灵若使用特效插件则需对应模组，但核心玩法不依赖）。

所有数据均通过持久化 NBT 存储，多人游戏完美同步。

📜 背景致敬
本模组灵感来源于江南所著《龙族》系列小说。血统分级、言灵序列号及部分效果设定均向原作致敬，但所有机制均为原创实现。


The Dream of Dragon
— Awaken your dragon lineage and chant world-ending incantations —

Have you ever imagined awakening the power of dragon blood hidden deep within your veins? The Dream of Dragon is a Minecraft Forge mod inspired by the novel "Dragon Raja", allowing you to truly become a hybrid – walking the path to the Dragon King through survival and combat.

✨ Core Features
🧬 Lineage System
At the start of each new game, you randomly obtain one of four lineage ranks: S / A / B / C. Your lineage determines your spirit recovery rate, the maximum rarity of incantations you can obtain, and permanent passive bonuses (e.g., S-rank grants health regeneration). Noble blood brings overwhelming power – but also a heavier destiny.

🗣️ Incantation System
Awaken over 20 unique incantations – from the flame jet of "Chi", the wind blade domain of "Kamaitachi", to the explosive fireball of "Kun Yen" and the nuclear blast of "Rhine". Each incantation has distinct visual effects and mechanics. Lower lineage players can only obtain rarer incantations with difficulty. Casting incantations consumes Spirit, and your Spirit regeneration rate is determined by your lineage – S-rank hybrids can fight almost non-stop, while C-rank must plan every move carefully.

💥 Blood Rage – Temporary Lineage Ascension
When facing powerful foes, you can actively trigger "Blood Rage" to temporarily raise your lineage (e.g., A → S), unlocking stronger incantations and buffs, but at the cost of debuffs like weakness and blindness. After 30 seconds, your lineage reverts, and you must bear the consequences.

🎭 Immersive Interactions
When you cast an incantation, all nearby players see a grand title and subtitle, with spectacular particles erupting from the caster.

Many incantations feature unique casting delays, particle trails, area suppression mechanics, etc., delivering a multi‑layered combat experience.

Future plans include boss battles against the Eight Kings, the White King, Odin, and more epic challenges.

⚙️ Technical Compatibility
Built entirely with MCreator 2024.4, supports Forge 1.20.1.

No mandatory dependencies – just drop in and play (optional visual enhancers may require additional mods, but core gameplay is self‑contained).

All data stored in persistent NBT, fully synchronized in multiplayer.

📜 Inspirational Credit
This mod is inspired by the "Dragon Raja" novel series by Jiang Nan. The lineage ranks, incantation serial numbers, and some ability effects are a respectful homage to the original work, while all mechanics are original implementations.

Download now and ignite your dragon soul!
